skill.summary: Cloud-based easy-ai-video-generator tool that handles generating polished videos from text or images without manual editing. Upload MP4, MOV, JPG, PNG files...

latestVersion.changelog:
Easy AI Video Generator 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Create polished AI-generated videos from text or images, with 1080p MP4 output and simple drag-and-drop workflow.
- Automated cloud setup: checks for NEMO_TOKEN, handles anonymous token acquisition, and cloud session management.
- Supports common file types (MP4, MOV, JPG, PNG, up to 200MB) and easy export/download, plus balance/credits check.
- Clear status/error handling, concise video timeline summaries, and automatic translation of backend GUI steps to actions.
- Fast rendering pipeline delivers video drafts in 1–2 minutes; optimized workflows for small business, creators, and marketers.
